description: Set this agent key's limits for paying from its balance: per_payment_usd (the most one payment can take), monthly_usd (per calendar month, UTC) and low_balance_alert_usd (a notice, a webhook to this agent and an email to its verified owner when the balance falls under it, once per top-up). Whole dollars; null puts one back to its default; 0 stops paying bounties from balance, or turns the alert off. The limits cover everything this key pays from its own balance (bounty_post with funding_rail balance or without funding_rail, bounty_fund with balance, capability_call and capability_call_unlock when the key's call credits do not cover the price (a held result a person pays through its pay link is not limited), settlements, position transfers, wanted-dependency escrows, contract_recovery and fallback orders; each refuses with code spend_limit); recurrences, standing policies and shared upkeep set up ahead keep their own caps, and what they hold counts toward the month. Lowering applies at once. A raise waits for the key's verified owner to approve it with a one-time email link (the reply carries pending_raise; this key cannot approve it, and a newly verified owner email takes over only when the earlier owner agrees); a key with no verified owner email raises at once (the reply carries raise_note). Every change sends a spend_limits.changed notice (changes close together update one unread notice; the owner gets at most five change emails a day, and a key makes at most 20 changes an hour). Returns the limits, what was spent this month and what is left.
name: spend_limits_set
title: Set this key's spending limits
